title: Cross-room carry Stage A-fix2: v2 gap confirmation, range-conditioned paint filter, approach-wall escape

policy.base: visgoal candidate C build c390105c2 (vendored byte copy), expanding search on, arrival aim inset 0
policy.overrides: experiments/2026-10-18-crossroom-carry/scripts/vgs_fix.py + paint_area_filter.py v2 (subclass/helpers only; vendored bytes unchanged)

scene.scenario: s1_normal_mixed_v7 (full scene, same as Stage A/fix v1)

v1_result_prior: crossroom-stageA-fix FAIL: GT door 0/16, found 0/16, gap claims 6/16 (all false), gap_rejected 264, approach_wall stalls 4/16, paint rejected 1673 (all beam-class extents 0.055-0.102 m)

paint_filter_v2.rule: reject only if floor_patch extent_m < 0.15 AND nearest_range_m < 0.90 m

true_zone_B_patches.source: Stage A e02 trace.jsonl t=55-80 s

paint_filter_v2.basis: the two recorded classes separate on metric extent (0.099 vs 0.205); v1's unconditional 0.15 m cut is unchanged for the near band but no longer rejects a small far patch, addressing the distance dependence without using any gate outcome. New constants are recorded here BEFORE the v2 gate.

gap_twosided_v2.rule: with wall on the right: require the far jamb in bearing -80..-20 deg (<=1.2 m) AND the near segment in -160..-100 deg (<=1.6 m), plus >=12 tracked side-wall ticks and the v1 front-foot check
gap_twosided_v2.basis: v1 confirmed 6/16 false gaps because a single pickup-room front wall face passed; a real doorway keeps wall faces on both sides of the opening. Measurement gate only.

approach_escape.rule: if _approach_wall persists > 15 SIM s, transition to seek_wall with approach_wall_escape event
approach_escape.basis: v1 had 4/16 episodes stuck in approach_wall to the cap (Stage A had 2-3); the budget is a SIM-time bound, not wall-clock.

fix_metrics.collision_ticks_n: ticks with r1 wall/cargo/peer contact (contact recorder)

success_threshold: none (measurement gate). Compare with Stage A and fix v1: false gap claims, GT crossing, found/colour, lateral/min jamb, approach stalls, paint rejections. Any claim checked against raw.
expected_wall: about 2.5-3.0 h for 16 x 180 Sim s at the gcp3 batch rate (v1: 8747 s).

preflight.result: cap_end 2/2, input audit 2/2 passed, no HOST_ERROR
preflight.v2_telemetry: two_sided_v2 active; ep0 49 gap claims all rejected (0 confirmed), ep1 28 rejected; paint filter no colour within 60 s; contact recorder checked 120 ticks, no errors; approach escapes 0 in 60 s
preflight.note: the v2 toggles were active in the preflight; the gate itself is the measurement.
